# Pandukabhaya mapping attribution

`SinhalaFontBridge.Core/Profiles/fm_abhaya.json` contains the FM Abhaya mapping from [akuruAI/Pandukabhaya](https://github.com/akuruAI/Pandukabhaya), with local font-family aliases added. `SinhalaFontBridge.Checks/test_cases.json` contains its published conversion examples.

The upstream mapping identifies its author as paarandika and its license as MIT. The upstream copyright notice is retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The FM Abhaya font itself is identified by the upstream metadata as proprietary. No font file is included in this repository or the portable package.
